notes.title: Hotfixes and More!
notes.notes:
Missions to master in OIAM, more to come!
Rebalanced the enemies to make them more fair in OIAM
Handful of othe minor bug fixes
New crosshairs, plus hovering over an AI enemy is fully functional

notes.title: Update to OIAM
notes.notes:
The previous best strategy was to stand still and shoot blind, that is changed now. The enemies are slightly harder but headshots are now a thing!

Changes:
[list]
[*] New reload upgrade
[*] Semi random pathing for enemies (current structure buffs the shot extension upgrade ["Bryce at full price"])
[*] Tighter shots from enemies, 10% variability down to 4, to offset the new difference
[*]More accurate shots from enemies, pitch and yaw readjusted
[/list]

Planned Upcoming Content:
[list]
[*] New helmets to show differences in enemy types easier
[*] Final boss for OIAM
[*] Achievements for OIAM
[*] Secret boss for OIAM
[*] Level 1 of the campaign
[/list]

notes.title: A taste of new content
notes.notes:
[b]New Character Design[/b]
The character appears more human, and more reactive, with [i]jiggle physics[/i] on the googly eyes

Revamped OIAM mode, with new and different options for powering up

And more to come...
